title: Nebula Cloud & Workbenches: Accelerating AI/ML Development

scenes.title: Introducing Nebula Cloud
scenes.narration: Nebula Cloud is a unified platform for data science and machine learning, simplifying complex workflows. It empowers teams to build and deploy AI models faster, reducing setup time by up to 70% compared to traditional environments.

scenes.title: The Workbench Concept
scenes.narration: At its heart, Nebula Cloud offers Workbenches: pre-configured, on-demand virtual environments. These eliminate tedious setup, providing instant access to powerful tools like Jupyter notebooks and RStudio.

scenes.title: Inside a Nebula Workbench
scenes.narration: Each workbench is a secure, isolated space, pre-loaded with essential tools like Python, R, and VS Code. It provides seamless access to your data and fosters team collaboration with shared projects.

scenes.title: Accelerating ML Development
scenes.narration: Nebula Workbenches accelerate the entire ML lifecycle, from rapid experimentation to model deployment. Data scientists can iterate 5x faster, focusing on algorithms instead of environment management.

scenes.title: Impact & Future of Nebula
scenes.narration: Nebula Cloud drives significant productivity gains, reduces operational costs, and enhances security for AI initiatives. It empowers organizations to innovate faster and scale their data science capabilities globally.
